setup: Standalone throwaway Worker `codex-probe` (scratch /tmp/cxp/worker.js + wrangler.toml, deployed by the owner with wrangler; Executor uploads failed, see the report). One script, two hosts: the Workers Custom Domain codex-probe.ianpascoe.dev (zone ianpascoe.dev, the zone of Commissary's ai.ianpascoe.dev) and codex-probe.ian-g-pascoe.workers.dev (control). Same code, same token, same Durable Object (`Probe`, one named object). Every endpoint gated by a bearer (only its SHA-256 in the code). /matrix runs in the stateless fetch handler, /matrix-do inside the Durable Object. /echo and each matrix first fetch httpbin.org/headers and postman-echo.com/headers to observe the cf-worker header of the subrequest.

signIn.flow: ChatGPT device code (auth.openai.com/api/accounts/deviceauth, client app_EMoamEEZ73f0CkXaXp7hrann), polled by the Durable Object's alarm every 5 s
